% pdflatex -halt-on-error -output-directory=<temporary directory> round-node-radii.tex
% ROUNDNODE lines give the full centerline diameters in integer scaled points.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{shapes.geometric}
\makeatletter
% label, box width/height/depth, inner x/ysep, minimum width/height
\newcommand{\RoundProbe}[8]{%
  \begingroup
  \pgfkeys{/pgf/.cd,inner xsep=#5,inner ysep=#6,minimum width=#7,minimum height=#8,outer sep=0pt}%
  \foreach \kind in {circle,ellipse}{%
    % Set the registers after packing: an hbox around a negative-depth rule
    % would report zero depth, unlike TikZ's explicit text depth override.
    \setbox\pgfnodeparttextbox=\hbox{}%
    \wd\pgfnodeparttextbox=#2\relax
    \ht\pgfnodeparttextbox=#3\relax
    \dp\pgfnodeparttextbox=#4\relax
    \pgfmultipartnode{\kind}{center}{probe}{\pgfusepath{discard}}%
    \pgf@process{\pgfpointdiff{\pgfpointanchor{probe}{west}}{\pgfpointanchor{probe}{east}}}%
    \edef\diameterx{\number\pgf@x}%
    \pgf@process{\pgfpointdiff{\pgfpointanchor{probe}{south}}{\pgfpointanchor{probe}{north}}}%
    \typeout{ROUNDNODE #1 \kind\space \diameterx\space \number\pgf@y}%
  }%
  \endgroup
}
\makeatother
